effect.maledict.age_of_darkness.descript: Burned through civilization, stripping a fifth of your magic resistance, Soul Ward capacity and Soul Ward integrity per level.
effect.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.des: Where ignorance and shadow were mistaken for divine, Your next strike is sealed as a critical blow. Each level grants an additional Reserve Staff Charge.
If endermen's magic were gathered into astral weave, soulwood might gain wondrous properties. A bow of this wood draws twice as fast, and its arrows fly faster and pierce blocks to a limited extent.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.male: Longing that would not cease compelled me to pour myself into the work. Thus, the Remembrance Bow gained the ability to fire automatically at full draw. I call it the Elegy Bow.
Perhaps falling into the well shattered my fear of the forbidden. Malignant pewter's hunger for the erosion of knowledge forged the Edge of Deliverance.

Could that rejection be transformed into an overt magical property? My earlier research reminded me that, if I could construct a dynamically stable environment, the pulses of the eight spirits might provoke the pulse of a ninth arcane energy to reveal itself.

At last I obtained this weapon. The will within the Edge of Deliverance was utterly devoured by the void. This emptiness hungers to consume everything, while the eight spirits submit entirely to its control; even their pulses are distorted, manifesting unexpected abilities.
As more spirits are offered, the weapon becomes ever more inscrutable. I have named it the Incursus Blade, and hope this void can be sated by the pulses.

Experience crystals have already proven this approach successful. Adding more of the power condensed within mnemonic fragments can make enchanting power shine even more brilliantly, reaching the astonishing strength of ten bookshelves.
By cleverly exploiting malignant metal's rejection of magic, the power of hallowed gold can be focused more intensely, producing an acceleration effect of one half.

Vicissitude is not something I created; it is only ever called. Three arcane spirits open a crack, four open it wider, and the same being decides how much of itself comes through. The order drawn on the recipe page is the order of the poles, bottom first.

Set eldritch spirits at the very bottom and the call reaches deeper: one eldritch brings the complete thing, two bring the face that no longer holds back. The eldritch does not moderate itself for my caution; it only pushes Vicissitude further than I dared to reach.
malum.gui.curio.effect.maledict.age_of_e: Doubles the speed of item cooldowns while worn
Slaying an enemy grants the Age of Enlightenment, or extends it if already held
Striking Half Health Targets Triggers Spirit Collection Effects
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.attac: Fate always drives people to the edge of a cliff, like an unwelcome guest calling.
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.curio: Every confiscated curio has been returned
%s curio(s) are still in custody: free up inventory or curio slots and they will be returned automatically
message.maledict.first_vicissitude.phase: Vicissitude is the fate even sages meet while walking the righteous path.
tooltip.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.ho: Hold Shift to ask a question better left unasked
tooltip.maledict.age_of_enlightenment.sh: Was there ever a true age of darkness?
That infinite, boundless, perpetual "Age of Enlightenment."
tooltip.maledict.curio_return_token: Right-click to reclaim confiscated curios that are still in custody. The token only disappears once everything has been handed back.
tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.descript: A evil scythe that devours spirits and strikes all around its wielder.

tooltip.maledict.incursus_blade.medium_u: When every spirit reaches the sacred number, a more intrinsic power will awaken.
